summary.text: George Brown, formally George A. Brown Jr., is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 77 who has served since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: George A. Brown Jr. was born in Lexington, Kentucky, graduated from Dunbar High School in 1966, and earned a bachelor of science in business administration from Tennessee State University.
His career experience includes working as a Supplier Diversity Business Enterprise Coordinator with the University of Kentucky Facilities Management.
He has been a member of the Kentucky Black Caucus of Local Elected Officials and the Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government Council.
Brown took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2015.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations and Revenue Committee, the Local Government Committee, and the Postsecondary Education Committee.
